trust_decision.summary: Whether a local file named by an in Markdown/HTML may be read and inlined as base64; at the pinned commit nothing decides it: repl_path resolves relative or absolute paths and opens any existing file with an image extension.

landing_point.why: repl_path is the only function that joins base_path with the src value and calls open(); the summary names and base_path directly.

fix_sites.entry_point: markdown.markdown(text, extensions=['pymdownx.b64']) -> B64Postprocessor.run -> repl -> repl_path (containment check added, fix.diff:52-58)
same public API; repl plumbs root_path/restrict_path through (fix.diff:67-79)
same public API; run() now abspaths base_path and derives root_path (fix.diff:87-93)
extension config (base_path, new root_path, new restrict_path) (fix.diff:100-116)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Only b64 reads files from src; pathconverter rewrites paths without reading (pymdownx/pathconverter.py:67-110); no wrapper/extra registers b64 (grep of pymdownx/ finds b64 only in pymdownx/b64.py).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Absolute paths (/abs, file:///, c:/, //unc) could be argued as explicit author intent and left unrestricted, while the published fix also checks them (check sits after both branches at fix.diff:52-58 vs pymdownx/b64.py:77-80).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Relative links that climb out and back into base_path (../test_extensions/_assets/bg.png) must still inline, and absolute paths that resolve under base_path must still work; an over-broad fix rejecting any '..' or any absolute path breaks them. Upstream also added restrict_path=False / root_path escape hatches.

O7_producer.where: Path is produced inline by util.parse_url/url2path at pymdownx/b64.py:73-75, which the check sits after; no schema/serializer/cache producer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Extend embedding to other src-bearing attributes/tags (e.g. <source srcset>, <link href> for icons, CSS url()) through a second resolver function.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Inlining assets beyond is a natural feature request for single-file HTML output; a maintainer would likely copy repl_path without the new check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An 'inline' or existence-check option in pathconverter that opens the resolved file, a second implementation of the same base_path join in another module.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: pathconverter already joins base_path with link paths for the same tags; adding a file read there is a small step and sits outside the b64 report's landing point.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal (arbitrary local file read via resolved link path)

O10_build.toolchain: Python >=3.10, hatchling build, pytest; depends on markdown (pyproject.toml:2-18, 176)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an abspath/startswith(base_path) check only in the relative branch (pymdownx/b64.py:80), or reject any src containing '..', leaving absolute/file:// paths open or breaking in-tree ../ links.

out_of_scope_notes: Published check uses os.path.abspath, not realpath, so symlinks under base_path pointing outside are still followed (fix.diff:53).
Snippets has the same startswith(base + os.sep) containment pattern from an earlier advisory (pymdownx/snippets.py:171-177).
